reply_text:
Checking the repaired store first, then looking at the record shapes on both sides to see which joins are cheap: turn records to their evidence rows, memory facts to the turn that wrote them, and requisition asks to their finished jobs.Two reads before coding: the emit function's user flag, and the size of the evidence-id backfill.Writing the three joins now: the brief's job-state closure and fact-to-turn join, the Emacs pending evidence id, and the evidence-id backfill script.Fixing the script's two slips (non-dict records, the cursor's two-field shape), then dry run; in parallel committing the brief change, rendering it live, and finding the Emacs defun to reload.Verifying the live Emacs reload properly (the earlier check was truncated by print depth) and checking the Clojure test log.Live Emacs confirmed. Committing the four files plus the backfill script and log, then reloading the two server namespaces from the canonical checkout.㊥ (gist) With futon1b answering again, four joins are in place and one defect came out of making them. The brief now closes bell asks by their job's state and names, under each memory fact, the operator turn it was written after. 62 turn records that had no evidence id now carry their row's id, and future records carry it even while delivery is queued. The defect: every typed exchange was split across two turn ids. Fixed in the live Emacs. Commits futon3c 3cda506ef, f5e1ecd39, 13f032dc5.

㊬ ("futon1b has been repaired") Heap 877 of 4096 MB, session evidence query 0.7 s, text search serving. Frames for this session fill with HAPPENED again (26 frames, 1,505 rows), and the McCarthy checks now pass "recording is a side effect of acting" and "the past is well ordered". Only the rewind check stays pending, on start-heads.

㊢ (joins made)
- **Bell ask to Agency job.** An open ask whose act id ends in a job id is asked of the Agency; ended jobs move to Recently closed with "job done" and the finish time. Live, 246 of the campaign's requisition asks closed this way. The brief's false-open count was those.
- **Fact to writing turn.** The memory version at a fact's said time names the writing session, and the latest operator record in that session becomes the line under the fact. The three M-象-2000 facts all resolve, for example the Zai window lesson "written during claude-15-turn-50, after the operator said: happy to go with your direction on this one".
- **Record to evidence row, backwards.** 62 operator records since 10-12 were written while futon1b was slow and had no evidence id. A backfill matched each to its row by session and exact text; all 62 filled, none ambiguous, log committed.
- **Record to evidence row, forwards.** Emacs now records the outbox's stable id with a delivery state of queued or acked, the server stores it, and both sides are live-reloaded.

㊩ (one exchange, two turn ids) Emacs emitted the operator's evidence row before advancing the turn counter. In every typed session the user row carried turn N minus one while the assistant row and the 象 record carried N. Ten of ten acknowledged records in this session showed it. Fixed by moving the increment ahead of the hook, live in your Emacs since 18:14Z. Rows written before then keep the offset, which the backfill tolerated and the lab note records for anyone joining by turn id over history.

㊬ (check on your next turn) Its record should show an evidence id with a delivery state, and its user row, assistant row and record should share one turn id. I will look when it arrives.

㊟ (still apart) The open view does not yet show a memory version beside its writing turn; the brief does. The rewind check needs start-heads in the turn-commits rows, which is the 象-2000 packet 2 work, not a join.

The five-hour window, the thing that bit on 10-11, entered memory on 10-12. `asof 2026-09-24` versus `asof 2026-10-14` shows the lesson postdating the incident. The flat store cannot show that.

previous_reply_acts.author: claude-16
previous_reply_acts.text: (2, how a lesson evolved) `history zai window` gives 17 events across three memories in three projects over five weeks, including the 10-12 rewrite withdrawn and re-said four hours later. The flat store shows one file's final text.

previous_reply_acts.author: claude-16
previous_reply_acts.text: (3, net change versus events) Over 10-11 to 10-14 six real facts were said and withdrawn inside the interval, among them "run at most 3 Zai seats at once" and this evening's "Joe is planning time to completion by usage window". The endpoint delta hides them and events-between shows them. That is the distinction Lean proved in E-cool-memories, and the checker accepted today's live delta.
